pages.text: Some full moons are special. Each has its own sky colour and its own music while it is up.
pages.title: Special Moons

pages.text: $(l)Harvest Moon$(): a quarter of full moons. Ripe crops broken under it drop twice.$(br2)$(l)Enchanted Moon$(): a tenth of full moons. The sky swings purple to pink, and enchanting costs no levels (lapis is still used).$(br2)$(l)Glimmer Moon$(): about one in six, teal. Mobs and ores drop twice the experience.
Each moon has a music disc: a 2% drop from a hostile mob a player kills under that moon.
